subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should the grouped action upgrades be approved together after a stable rebase and exact-head workflow validation, or should the credential/publishing/Codex action changes be reviewed separately?
rationale: These official dependency updates alter executable code at security and release boundaries, so accepting the grouped blast radius requires explicit repository-owner judgment even though no concrete patch defect was found.

options.title: Validate and approve together
options.body: Rebase to current main, verify all official hashes, and approve the group only after exact-head security, token, Codex-agent, Docker, and workflow-sanity checks pass or have attributable unrelated failures.

options.title: Split sensitive actions
options.body: Separate credential, publishing, CodeQL, and Codex Action pins from lower-risk tool-setup pins so each security boundary can be reviewed and rolled back independently.

options.title: Pause the grouped update
options.body: Leave the PR open or close it in favor of smaller updates if Dependabot cannot produce a stable, reviewable head with attributable checks.

recommendation.title: Validate and approve together
recommendation.body: Rebase to current main, verify all official hashes, and approve the group only after exact-head security, token, Codex-agent, Docker, and workflow-sanity checks pass or have attributable unrelated failures.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest file-history signal spans the central CI, Docker release, action-modernization, and Codex-agent workflow surfaces affected by the decision.
